summary:
Implemented parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError in rdflib/extras/shacl.py and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (38 passed) under the prepared venv's Python. Nothing is committed; git status shows only the two new files.

Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the prepared venv and were not installed. Type-ignore placement and the 88-column limit were checked by reading the code and with awk. The type-ignore on the `with pytest.raises(expected):` line follows the spec but may be reported as unused by mypy.
